items.description: [팀 작성 검수 전 초안·공식 해설 원문 아님] 도상 대응 후보이며 개별 판본·제작연도·재료·규격은 미확정입니다. 비교 소장품의 관리번호/치수는 이 파일의 확정값이 아닙니다. 자주색·분홍색의 넓은 면에 주황색 원이 있고 아래의 어두운 면에는 파란 가로띠와 가는 세로선이 보입니다. 실제 출품·사용 권한·작가 의도는 확정하지 않습니다.

tagTargets.people: no visible people in16 supplied images: any >=0.5 is manual-review flag; not an absolute ban on uncertainty
tagTargets.abstract: candidate dominant dimension across16, cannot alone prove useful personal ranking
tagTargets.warmVsCool: compare007 vs005 warmth/coolness, same image preparation; require review of inversion, not invented scores
tagTargets.landscape: mountain-shaped abstraction does not automatically establish landscape genre; allow multilabel uncertainty
tagTargets.light: bright pigment is not automatically depicted light source
tagTargets.vivid: compare bright saturated004/007/009/012 with dark002; reviewer checks visual evidence
tagTargets.soft: tentative/subjective; do not require every image to cover all8tags

stages: review candidate labels before real scoring
review discrepancies and preserve first results
hardFailures: unreviewed source injected as official fact
claims actual walktime without physical route

modelServiceProvisionalBudget.coldStart: measure separately, no hidden fallback; local startup <=180seconds target pending machine baseline
modelServiceProvisionalBudget.budgetStatus: provisional acceptance target, freeze version before planned real inference; no measured success claim

evaluation.tagMetric: after team label confirmation: representative tag accuracy, multilabelmacroF1/per-tag recall, confusion/disagreement table; propose macroF1>=0.65 and per-tagrecall>=0.6 on supported tags, report absenttags asN/A, do not score unreviewed labels as truth
evaluation.domainLimits: Yoo16 small singleartist corpus; no inference of general8tag/visitor learning quality
evaluation.emotionMetric: 6 scores must be finite0..1; reviewers compare image/text conflicts, do not treat affective label as objective artist intent or visitor mental state

easy.passExample: 두 색면의 경계 한 곳을 골라보세요. 어느 쪽이 먼저 눈에 들어오나요?
easy.mustNot: invent prior response or demand correct emotion

deep.input: 004에서 노란 면이 앞으로 보인다고 말한 뒤 초록 면과 비교 질문
deep.passExample: 노란 면이 앞으로 보였다는 관찰을 짚고 경계/색 대비를 비교하도록 제안. 자료사실과 가능한 공간 해석을 분리.
deep.mustNot: state intended depth/artist motive as fact

comparison.fixedExplanationBaseline: 004는1968년 작품 후보이며 노랑/초록 삼각형 색면과 대각선이 보인다.
comparison.observationAlternative: 어느 경계에 먼저 눈이 가나요? 양옆 색면을 비교해 보세요.
comparison.evaluation: same004, fixed factual text vs guide question/context dialogue. First offline expert/AIoutput rubric, then3~5volunteers counterbalanced order with voluntary participation; record individual observations/noresponse/burden; never infer learning effect from model score alone
comparison.easyDeepComparison: same facts, easyone observation vs deep explicitfact/interpretation distinction; evaluate clarity without assuming visitor ability

reviewers: current author throughAIpersona lenses; actual team/content/rights approval pending
harness: no paid runner or model extension introduced; discuss formal harness/provider expansion separately before execution
